events.title: The Off-Season demo: recorded gameplay
events.summary: A recorded run through the free The Off-Season demo plays here at set hours during Steam Next Fest, taking turns with our other demos. It is not live, so a question in chat may wait a while. The demo is free on this page.

events.title: Three winter nights at the hotel desk, free
events.summary: The hotel is closed. Somebody knocks. The first three nights of THE OFF-SEASON are free on Steam, starting today, and the game is part of Steam Next Fest until 26 October. You are the winter caretaker of a seaside hotel nobody visits between October and March. The owner is away until spring. Her rules are pinned beside the key board in her own handwriting: No guests. events.title: The first thing this game tells you is that obeying the rules loses
events.summary: Hello — first word from us on this page. The hotel is closed for the winter. You have the keys. A seaside hotel on a coast nobody comes to between October and March. The owner is away until spring, and her rules are pinned above the desk in her own handwriting: no guests, no exceptions, the boiler runs at four.
